description.en: A Model Context Protocol server that enables Claude and other LLMs to interact with Notion workspaces, providing capabilities like searching, retrieving, creating and updating pages, as well as managing databases.
description.zh-Hans: 一种模型上下文协议服务器，使克劳德和其他大型语言模型能够与Notion工作区互动，提供搜索、检索、创建和更新页面以及管理数据库等功能。
